title: The Intercession of Christ
definition: The intercession of Christ means that Jesus continually represents and prays for His people before the Father.
summary: Believers are kept not by their own strength, but by the living Savior who intercedes for them.
christFocus: Christ is the faithful High Priest who brings His people near and sustains them by grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers are kept not by their own strength, but by the living Savior who intercedes for them.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
